name: Suspension Push-Up
steps: Face away from the anchor and grasp both low handles, then step back into an inclined plank.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly while stabilizing the handles directly below your shoulders.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your ribs to lower your chest slowly between the handles.
Press powerfully through both handles to extend your arms back to lockout while keeping the straps clear of your upper arms.
tips: Avoid resting the straps heavily against your shoulders for stability; control them with your chest and core.
Keep your body straight from head to heels without letting your hips sag.
